---
title: "`r params$title`"
author: "`r params$author`"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 3
    theme:
      bootswatch: cerulean
      primary: "#7B2D8E"
params:
  experiment: NULL
  results: NULL
  title: "cellreportR analysis report"
  author: ""
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 100
)
experiment <- params$experiment
results <- params$results
```

## Experimental setup

```{r setup-table}
spatial <- experiment$spatial_unit
cat(sprintf(
  "Cells: **%d** across **%d** %ss  \nChannels: **%s**  \nTreatments: %s\n",
  nrow(experiment$cells),
  length(unique(experiment$cells[[spatial]])),
  spatial,
  paste(experiment$channels$channel, collapse = ", "),
  paste(unique(experiment$design$treatment), collapse = ", ")
))
```

### Design preview

```{r design}
knitr::kable(utils::head(experiment$design, 20))
```

### Channel panel

```{r channels}
knitr::kable(experiment$channels)
```

## Quality control

```{r qc}
if (nrow(experiment$qc_log)) {
  knitr::kable(experiment$qc_log)
} else {
  cat("_No QC steps applied._\n")
}
```

```{r qc-plot}
cellreportR::cr_plot_qc(experiment)
```

## Intensity overview

```{r intensity-panels}
for (ch in experiment$channels$channel) {
  print(cellreportR::cr_plot_intensity(experiment, ch))
}
```

## Results summary

```{r summary}
if (length(results)) {
  summ <- attr(results, "summary")
  if (!is.null(summ)) {
    knitr::kable(summ, digits = 4)
  }
} else {
  cat("_No statistical analyses included._\n")
}
```

```{r effect-size-plot, eval = length(results) > 0}
cellreportR::cr_plot_effect_sizes(results)
```

```{r foldchange-plot, eval = length(results) > 0}
cellreportR::cr_plot_foldchange(results)
```

## Plate overview

```{r plate}
cellreportR::cr_plot_plate(experiment, experiment$channels$channel[1])
```

## Session info

```{r session, results = "markup"}
utils::sessionInfo()
```
